Name: Jehoshaphat, Son of Ahilud
Summary: Jehoshaphat, son of Ahilud, was David's recorder — the officer who kept the chronicles of the reign — through David's administration and into the revolt of Sheba.
KeyStory: Jehoshaphat kept the chronicle of David's reign from its height through its civil wars.
RelatedPeople: King David; Ahilud, Father of Jehoshaphat; Joab; King Solomon; Ahilud, Father of Jehoshaphat the Recorder
LifeLesson: Someone must write the chronicle, even the chapters the king would rather forget.
